master: Logo design presentation board for Karman Prep, a premium SAT preparation company for well-off families: small live cohorts that each end on one specific SAT test date, private one-on-one tutoring over Zoom, and a daily practice app. The name comes from the Karman line, the boundary 100 km up where the sky ends and space begins: the line you rise past. That idea, rising past a line, is the thinking behind the mark. Approach it the way Allan Peters designs brand marks: one simple, memorable, ownable symbol that merges two ideas into a single shape, using negative space, overlapping shapes, rhythm, an unexpected twist or visual flow. It must stay clear at 16 pixels and in one colour. Do not force a letterform. Avoid stiff, jagged, angular construction; prefer confident curves, calm proportions and generous space. The wordmark 'Karman Prep' should be beautifully drawn lettering with real character, such as a refined high-contrast serif or a warm humanist sans, never a generic techy geometric font; spelled exactly Karman Prep. Layout: black artwork on a plain white background. On the left, the symbol alone, large. On the right, the symbol with the wordmark beside it. Flat 2D vector only: no gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockups, colour, taglines or extra text. No clichés: no graduation caps, owls, books, pencils, lightbulbs, rockets, ringed planets, swooshes or globes. The feeling: established, calm and confident, like a respected old institution with a modern edge.
concepts: The symbol contains no letter. One smooth arc rises from below a single horizontal line and passes through it, like the top of a sun or a flight path clearing the horizon. Simple enough to be drawn from memory.

The symbol contains no letter. It captures the instant something crosses a line: a straight horizontal line and one confident curved form that breaks through it, with the overlap handled in negative space.
The symbol contains no letter. Concentric arcs like the layers of the sky, spaced with a calm rhythm, with one line standing apart as the edge of space. Feels like a classic emblem.

No separate symbol: a wordmark-only logo. Custom lettering for Karman Prep with one subtle, elegant detail that suggests a line being risen past, discovered on a second look. On the left, show the wordmark large; on the right, a small version and a single-letter favicon cut from the same lettering.
The symbol is a capital K drawn as one continuous, flowing monoline with rounded ends, which rises and passes over a single horizontal line. Fluid and graceful, not angular.
The symbol is a classic high-contrast serif capital K, like the monogram of a luxury house or an old university, with one fine horizontal line passing behind it that the letter clearly stands above.
The symbol is a K whose arm and leg are smooth curves rather than straight strokes, like a path rising and then levelling off past a horizon line. Soft, balanced, memorable.
Use your strongest idea for rising past a line. Use the letter K only if it makes the symbol better; a symbol with no letter at all is welcome.
